name: Honor Students
summary: In Thelsamar, Brock Stoneseeker sends an order for honorary mining picks to Ironforge. He asks you to enlist gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson to carry it there.

sections.title: A Miner's Due
sections.body: In Thelsamar, Brock Stoneseeker trains new miners in rock composition and tunnel safety. The town depends on mining, and its dwarves take pride in the craft. Brock gives honorary picks to apprentices who distinguish themselves in training. Local supplies are limited, so the picks must come from Ironforge, across Khaz Modan.

sections.title: Taking to the Skies
sections.body: Thelsamar's gryphon roost links the frontier to Ironforge through the kingdom's aerial courier network. Gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson tends the roost beside town. Brock asks you to bring his order to Thorgrum, who can arrange a swift courier run to the capital and its foundries.

faq.answer: Brock Stoneseeker teaches mining in Thelsamar. He trains novices in excavation and stonecraft.

faq.q: Why does Brock need picks from Ironforge?
faq.answer: Brock needs honorary picks for his high-achieving mining students, and local supplies are limited. The order must reach Golnir Bouldertoe, a mining supplies vendor in Ironforge.

faq.q: What role does Thorgrum Borrelson play in this task?
faq.answer: Thorgrum Borrelson tends Thelsamar's gryphon roost. Brock asks you to bring him the order so he can arrange aerial transport to Ironforge.

faq.q: Who receives the list in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Golnir Bouldertoe receives the list in Ironforge and prepares the honorary picks for Brock's accomplished students.

faq.q: Where does this errand lead next?
faq.answer: After you speak with Thorgrum Borrelson, he arranges a gryphon flight to Ironforge, where you can deliver Brock's order to Golnir Bouldertoe.

faq.q: Where does this task take place?
faq.answer: You begin and finish in Thelsamar, a settlement in the hills of Loch Modan.

angles.text: As a miner, you see how dwarves honor skill in the craft: mastering stone and finding veins can earn recognition from an instructor.
As a dwarf, you see the bond between frontier settlements like Thelsamar and the capital's halls deep in the mountains.
As an Alliance traveler in Loch Modan, you encounter the network of flight masters and aerial couriers that links its settlements.
